claim.claim-text: 1. MK-0677 for use in a method of treating growth hormone deficiency (GHD) in children, comprising administering a therapeutically effective amount of MK-0677 to a child known to have short stature and equivalent growth potential compared to rhGH, wherein the therapeutically effective amount is 0.1-0.8 mg/kg/d and a child has equivalent growth potential compared to rhGH when the child has:
(i) a peak serum GH ≥5 µg/L in response to a single oral dose of MK-0677; and (ii) a baseline serum IGF-I of >30 ng/mL.

2. MK-0677 for use in a method of treating growth hormone deficiency (GHD) in children, comprising administering a therapeutically effective amount of MK-0677 to a child known to have short stature and equivalent growth potential compared to rhGH, wherein the therapeutically effective amount is 0.8-2.0 mg/kg/d and a child has equivalent growth potential compared to rhGH when the child has:
(i) a peak serum GH ≥5 µg/L in response to a single oral dose of MK-0677; and (ii) a baseline serum IGF-I of >30 ng/mL.
3. MK-0677 for use according to claim 1 or 2, wherein MK-0677 is orally administered via at least one mini-tablet, comprising MK-0677.
4. MK-0677 for use according to claim 3, wherein the mini-tablet comprises 2 mg of MK-0677.
5. MK-0677 for use according to claim 3, wherein the mini-tablet comprises 4 mg of MK-0677.
6. MK-0677 for use according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the GHD is pediatric GHD.

7. MK-0677 for use according to claim 1 or 2, wherein MK-0677 is orally administered and the orally administering, further comprises administering with the assistance of a device capable of dispensing at least one MK-0677 mini-tablet.
8. MK-0677 for use according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the treatment is maintained for more than 6 months.
9. MK-0677 for use according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the treatment is maintained for at least 7 months.
10. MK-0677 for use according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the treatment is maintained until growth potential is exhausted.
11. A method for assessing a theranostic test for treating a child having a growth hormone deficiency, comprising:
(i) testing a sample from the child for a peak serum GH ≥5 µg/L in response to a single oral dose of MK-0677; and (ii) testing a sample from the child for a baseline serum IGF-I of >30 ng/mL.
12. The method of claim 11, wherein the testing for peak serum comprises, before obtaining the sample:
(a) administering a single, oral dose of MK-0677 to the child; and, (b) testing the GH serum levels achieved after administering MK-0677 to determine the child's peak serum GH level.
